crossRefs.note: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and…
You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.

translations.web: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;
translations.bsb: For he and his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,
translations.kjv: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
translations.asv: For he was amazed, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken;
